description:
This EP is a love letter to one of my all time favorite singers and people, Erin Bentlage. A few months ago Erin wrote and recorded an incredible acapella arrangement of her original song "I Would" and posted it on instagram. I was so memorized by it, I downloaded the video and listened all day. For the next week I made beats sampling the arrangement in different ways, and those beats turned into this EP. 

"Sunset"is her original arrangement. I wanted to include it on the EP because it ties everything together and because it's SO beautiful! 

It's a very short EP but my hope is that it flows and plays like one extended song. Hope you enjoy!
credits:
Sunset: written, arranged, and performed by Erin Bentlage (@erinbentlage)

Rest of the EP: 
Recorded, produced, and mixed by Amber Navran
